credential_setup.provisioning: private-beta Studio Skills API token provisioned by Stingray; browser token-management UI is not part of the first public slice

actions.name: idea.intake
actions.capability: Create or refine a normal Studio Idea from external context.
actions.example_prompt: Turn this BTC pullback thesis into a Studio Idea.

actions.name: evidence.ground
actions.capability: Ground Evidence or check market/data coverage for a selected Idea.
actions.example_prompt: Ground the current Idea and tell me whether the data supports a Replay.

actions.name: signal.design
actions.capability: Translate caller intent into Signal design context or staged Signal candidates.
actions.example_prompt: Design a Signal for the current Idea and stage a candidate if enough context is available.

actions.name: artifact.accept
actions.capability: Accept a selected staged Signal candidate and create a new committed Signal.
actions.example_prompt: Accept the staged Signal candidate and create the committed Signal.

actions.name: signal.replay
actions.capability: Run or explain Replay work for a selected active Signal.
actions.example_prompt: Run a private Replay for the selected Signal.

actions.name: signal.status
actions.capability: Read selected Signal status and latest Replay status without invoking the assistant runtime.
actions.example_prompt: Check whether the selected Signal Replay is complete.

actions.name: idea.publish
actions.capability: Publish the committed active-Idea state as a public Studio Publication.
actions.example_prompt: Publish a public Studio demo link for the current Idea.

default_flow: evidence.ground when context or coverage is unclear
artifact.accept when a staged Signal candidate should be committed
signal.status or lookup routes for recovery
idea.publish only after explicit public-share intent

current_data_coverage.summary: Use Studio actions for coverage checks. Public examples should prefer generic BTC movement Signals and Hyperliquid funding-rate Signals for Replay.

boundaries: no wallet, signing, transfer, or delegated wallet operations
no monitor lifecycle mutation in the first public slice
no billing, admin, guest, internal, webhook, tool-host, Slack install, social posting, or X link-claiming actions
no API token creation from an API-token-authenticated agent
no public Studio Publication unless the user explicitly asks to publish or share
